## (pairwise log comparision) for all possble groups (timepoints + tissue)

```{r}
library(limma)

# keep all desired timepoints (here: all non-NA)
samples_sub <- samples
L_sub <- L

tp <- factor(as.character(samples_sub$timepoint),
             levels = c("d0","d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5"))

keep <- !is.na(tp)
samples_sub <- droplevels(samples_sub[keep, , drop=FALSE])
L_sub <- L_sub[keep, , drop=FALSE]
tp <- droplevels(tp[keep])

# ---- build pairwise log-ratios (same as your code) ----
eps <- 1e-8
N <- nrow(L_sub); K <- ncol(L_sub)
pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=n_pairs)
for (p in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p,1]; k2 <- pair_mat[p,2]
  log_ratio_mat[,p] <- log(L_sub[,k1] + eps) - log(L_sub[,k2] + eps)
}
colnames(log_ratio_mat) <- apply(pair_mat, 1, \(idx) paste0("T",idx[1],"_vs_T",idx[2]))
Y_lr <- t(log_ratio_mat)



```

```{r}
library(limma)

tp <- factor(
  as.character(samples$timepoint),
  levels = c("d0","d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5")
)

tp <- relevel(tp, ref = "d0")   # <-- set reference
keep <- !is.na(tp)
samples_sub <- droplevels(samples[keep, , drop = FALSE])
L_sub <- L[keep, , drop = FALSE]
tp <- droplevels(tp[keep])
eps <- 1e-8
N <- nrow(L_sub)
K <- ncol(L_sub)

pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)

for (p in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
  k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
  log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log(L_sub[, k1] + eps) -
                        log(L_sub[, k2] + eps)
}

colnames(log_ratio_mat) <-
  apply(pair_mat, 1, \(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2]))

Y_lr <- t(log_ratio_mat)   # features × samples
design <- model.matrix(~ tp + tissue, data = samples_sub)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
fit <- lmFit(Y_lr, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1) Identify the time coefficients (exclude intercept + tissue) ---
coef_names <- colnames(fit$p.value)

# keep only tp* coefficients (these are vs d0 because you used relevel(tp, "d0"))
tp_coefs <- grep("^tp", coef_names, value = TRUE)

# --- 2) Parse topic indices from feature names like "T7_vs_T14" ---
pair_names <- rownames(fit$p.value)  # should match rownames(Y_lr)
parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(pair_names, "_vs_"))
k1 <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[,1]))
k2 <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[,2]))

K <- max(c(k1, k2))  # or set explicitly to ncol(L_sub)

# --- 3) Build full grid (topic x topic) once ---
base_grid <- expand.grid(k1 = 1:K, k2 = 1:K)
base_grid <- base_grid[base_grid$k1 != base_grid$k2, , drop = FALSE]  # remove diagonal

# helper to build symmetric heatmap grid for one coefficient
make_grid_for_coef <- function(coef) {
  pvals <- fit$p.value[, coef]
  qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")  # BH PER COEFFICIENT
  sig   <- qvals < 0.05

  df_pairs <- data.frame(k1 = k1, k2 = k2, sig = sig)

  # upper triangle
  m1 <- merge(base_grid, df_pairs, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)

  # lower triangle (swap)
  df_swapped <- transform(df_pairs, k1 = k2, k2 = k1)
  m2 <- merge(base_grid, df_swapped, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)

  base_grid$sig <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$sig), m1$sig, m2$sig)
  base_grid$coef <- coef
  base_grid
}

grid_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp_coefs, make_grid_for_coef))

# --- 4) Plot: one heatmap per coefficient ---
ggplot(grid_all, aes(x = factor(k1), y = factor(k2), fill = sig)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey90"),
                    na.value = "grey95", name = "BH < 0.05") +
  facet_wrap(~ coef, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant topic-pair changes vs d0 (per time coefficient)",
    x = "Topic k1",
    y = "Topic k2"
  )
```
```{r}
make_grid_for_coef2 <- function(coef) {
  pvals <- fit$p.value[, coef]
  qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")  # BH PER COEFFICIENT
  neglog10FDR <- -log10(qvals)

  df_pairs <- data.frame(k1 = k1, k2 = k2, neglog10FDR = neglog10FDR)

  m1 <- merge(base_grid, df_pairs, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)
  df_swapped <- transform(df_pairs, k1 = k2, k2 = k1)
  m2 <- merge(base_grid, df_swapped, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)

  base_grid$neglog10FDR <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$neglog10FDR), m1$neglog10FDR, m2$neglog10FDR)
  base_grid$coef <- coef
  base_grid
}

grid_all2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp_coefs, make_grid_for_coef2))

ggplot(grid_all2, aes(x = factor(k1), y = factor(k2), fill = neglog10FDR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "-log10(BH q)") +
  facet_wrap(~ coef, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise topic comparison vs d0 (per time coefficient)",
    x = "Topic k1",
    y = "Topic k2"
  )
```

```{r}
make_grid_for_coef_signedsig <- function(coef) {
  pvals <- fit$p.value[, coef]
  qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  lfc   <- fit$coefficients[, coef]

  df_pairs <- data.frame(
    k1 = k1, k2 = k2,
    q = qvals,
    lfc = lfc
  )

  m1 <- merge(base_grid, df_pairs, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)
  df_swapped <- transform(df_pairs, k1 = k2, k2 = k1)
  m2 <- merge(base_grid, df_swapped, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)

  base_grid$q   <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$q),   m1$q,   m2$q)
  base_grid$lfc <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$lfc), m1$lfc, m2$lfc)

  # signed significance
  base_grid$signed_sig <- ifelse(base_grid$q < 0.05,
                                 sign(base_grid$lfc) * (-log10(base_grid$q)),
                                 0)

  base_grid$coef <- coef
  base_grid
}

grid_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp_coefs, make_grid_for_coef_signedsig))

cap <- 5   # cap intensity (adjust)
grid_all$signed_sig_cap <- pmax(pmin(grid_all$signed_sig, cap), -cap)

ggplot(grid_all, aes(x = factor(k1), y = factor(k2), fill = signed_sig_cap)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "grey95", high = "red",
    limits = c(-cap, cap),
    name = "sign(logFC)\n× -log10(BH)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ coef, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Signed significance of pairwise changes vs d0 (per time coefficient)",
    x = "Topic k1",
    y = "Topic k2"
  )

```
```{r}
make_grid_for_coef_signedsig_all <- function(coef) {
  pvals <- fit$p.value[, coef]
  qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  lfc   <- fit$coefficients[, coef]

  df_pairs <- data.frame(k1 = k1, k2 = k2, q = qvals, lfc = lfc)

  m1 <- merge(base_grid, df_pairs, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)
  df_swapped <- transform(df_pairs, k1 = k2, k2 = k1)
  m2 <- merge(base_grid, df_swapped, by = c("k1","k2"), all.x = TRUE)

  base_grid$q   <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$q),   m1$q,   m2$q)
  base_grid$lfc <- ifelse(!is.na(m1$lfc), m1$lfc, m2$lfc)
  base_grid$sig <- base_grid$q < 0.05

  base_grid$signed_sig <- sign(base_grid$lfc) * (-log10(base_grid$q + 1e-300))
  base_grid$coef <- coef
  base_grid
}

grid_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp_coefs, make_grid_for_coef_signedsig_all))

cap <- 5
grid_all$signed_sig_cap <- pmax(pmin(grid_all$signed_sig, cap), -cap)

ggplot(grid_all, aes(x = factor(k1), y = factor(k2))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = signed_sig_cap), color = "white") +
  geom_tile(
    data = subset(grid_all, sig),
    fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "grey95", high = "red",
    limits = c(-cap, cap),
    name = "sign(logFC)\n× -log10(BH)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ coef, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise changes vs d0 (fill=signed significance; box=BH<0.05)",
    x = "Topic k1",
    y = "Topic k2"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

cf <- "tpd3"

make_matrices_for_coef <- function(coef) {
  pvals <- fit$p.value[, coef]
  qvals <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  lfc   <- fit$coefficients[, coef]

  M_lfc <- matrix(0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  M_sig <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = K, ncol = K)

  rownames(M_lfc) <- colnames(M_lfc) <- paste0("T", 1:K)
  rownames(M_sig) <- colnames(M_sig) <- paste0("T", 1:K)

  for (i in seq_along(lfc)) {
    a <- k1[i]; b <- k2[i]

    M_lfc[a, b] <-  lfc[i]
    M_lfc[b, a] <- -lfc[i]

    if (qvals[i] < 0.05) {
      M_sig[a, b] <- TRUE
      M_sig[b, a] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  diag(M_lfc) <- NA
  diag(M_sig) <- NA

  list(lfc = M_lfc, sig = M_sig)
}

M_list <- make_matrices_for_coef(cf)
M025   <- M_list$lfc
Sig025 <- M_list$sig
rng <- quantile(abs(M025), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-rng, 0, rng),
  c("#2c7bb6", "grey95", "#d7191c")
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  M025,
  name = "logFC",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "grey90",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_title = "tpd3 (d3 − d0)",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.6),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(Sig025[i, j]) && Sig025[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x, y, width, height,
        gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)
      )
    }
  }
)

draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")

```
## check similarity between topic prorpotions
```{r}


library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

cosine_sim_mat <- function(M) {
  # M: N x K
  M <- as.matrix(M)
  norms <- sqrt(colSums(M^2)) + 1e-12
  S <- t(M) %*% M
  S <- S / (norms %o% norms)
  S
}

S <- cosine_sim_mat(L)     # K x K
colnames(S) <- rownames(S) <- paste0("T", 1:ncol(L_sub))

df <- melt(S, varnames = c("Topic1", "Topic2"), value.name = "cos_sim")

ggplot(df, aes(Topic1, Topic2, fill = cos_sim)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Cosine similarity of topic proportions across samples",
       fill = "cosine")

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

S <- cosine_sim_mat(L)    # K x K
colnames(S) <- rownames(S) <- paste0("T", 1:ncol(L))
diag(S) <- NA             # optional: hide diagonal

df <- melt(S, varnames = c("Topic1", "Topic2"), value.name = "cos_sim")
df <- df[!is.na(df$cos_sim), ]

df$cos_bin <- cut(
  df$cos_sim,
  breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = FALSE
)
ggplot(df, aes(Topic1, Topic2, fill = cos_bin)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    name = "Cosine similarity\n(binned)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cosine similarity of topic proportions across samples",
    x = "Topic",
    y = "Topic"
  )

```
```{r}
library(reshape2)

cosine_sim_mat <- function(M) {
  M <- as.matrix(M)              # N x K
  norms <- sqrt(colSums(M^2)) + 1e-12
  S <- t(M) %*% M                # K x K
  S <- S / (norms %o% norms)
  S
}

# Ensure row alignment between L and samples
stopifnot(nrow(L) == nrow(samples))

tp <- factor(as.character(samples$timepoint),
             levels = c("d0","d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5"))

tp_levels <- levels(tp)

df_list <- list()

for (t in tp_levels) {
  idx <- which(tp == t)
  if (length(idx) < 2) next   # need >=2 samples to be meaningful

  Lt <- L[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  S_t <- cosine_sim_mat(Lt)

  colnames(S_t) <- rownames(S_t) <- paste0("T", 1:ncol(L))
  diag(S_t) <- NA

  df_t <- melt(S_t, varnames = c("Topic1","Topic2"), value.name = "cos_sim")
  df_t$timepoint <- t
  df_list[[t]] <- df_t
}

df_all <- do.call(rbind, df_list)

```


```{r}
df_all$cos_bin <- cut(
  df_all$cos_sim,
  breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = FALSE
)

ggplot(df_all, aes(Topic1, Topic2, fill = cos_bin)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd", name = "Cosine\n(binned)") +
  labs(title = "Binned cosine similarity within each timepoint",
       x = "Topic", y = "Topic")
```
